claims.claim_text: Date of Incident: January 8, 2023
claims.evidence_observations: The title card at 00:13 states 'SUNDAY, JANUARY 8, 2023 AT 8:47 A.M.' which confirms the date of the incident.

claims.claim_text: Time of Incident: Approximately 0846 hours
claims.evidence_observations: The title card states the time was 8:47 A.M., while the claim states approximately 0846 hours. The transcript at 01:08 states 'the cases are turned over... to an experienced Deputy district attorney for legal review...' but does not specify the exact time of the incident itself, though the title card is the primary source for the time.

claims.claim_text: Location: Warner Avenue at Red Hill Avenue, Tustin, CA
claims.evidence_observations: The title card states the location is 'WARNER AVENUE AND COMPASS AVENUE, TUSTIN CA', while the claim states 'Warner Avenue at Red Hill Avenue'. The video does not show Red Hill Avenue.

claims.claim_text: Reporting Officer: Officer D. Brandt
claims.evidence_observations: The video identifies Officer Joseph Sanchez as the officer recording the footage (visible in yellow text), not Officer D. Brandt as claimed.

claims.claim_text: Badge Number: 5391
Subject: Ricardo Flores, Male, 52 years old, Hispanic, grey jacket, black jeans
claims.evidence_observations: The subject is seen wearing a light-colored (white or light grey) jacket and dark pants, not a grey jacket and black jeans as described in the claim. The pants appear to be grey or faded blue jeans, not black.

claims.claim_text: Officer(s): Officer D. Brandt (handling officer), Officer M. Torres (backup), Officer K. Vega (less-lethal)
claims.evidence_observations: The video shows two officers with drawn weapons (Officer Diaz and another officer), but no third officer (Officer K. Vega) is visible or mentioned in the immediate audio/visual context of the clip. The claim lists three officers, but only two are clearly engaged in the confrontation shown.

claims.claim_text: Witness(es): Reporting Party 3 (RP-3, anonymous 9-1-1 caller)
claims.evidence_observations: The transcript states 'the following is the 9-1-1 call to the Tustin Police Department regarding Mejia', indicating the reporting party is anonymous (RP-3).

claims.claim_text: On Sunday, January 8, 2023, at approximately 0837 hours, the Tustin Police Department received a 9-1-1 call from RP-3 regarding a male Hispanic walking westbound on Warner Avenue at Red Hill Avenue carrying a large knife in his bloody hands.
claims.evidence_observations: The transcript states the caller was 'walking down Warner towards Red Hill' (eastbound), while the claim states 'walking westbound on Warner Avenue at Red Hill Avenue'. The direction of travel is contradictory.

claims.claim_text: I was designated as the handling officer and responded to the location.
claims.evidence_observations: The officer states 'I got it' and 'Lethal' while approaching the subject, indicating he identified himself as the handling officer and took charge of the situation.

claims.claim_text: Officer Torres was dispatched as backup.
Upon arrival at approximately 0846 hours, I parked my patrol vehicle along the east curb of Warner Avenue north of Compass Avenue.
claims.evidence_observations: The transcript states the officer parked 'along the east curb of Warner Avenue north of Compass Avenue,' but the video clip shows the officer exiting the vehicle on what appears to be the west side of the street (based on the direction of travel and sidewalk position), suggesting a potential conflict with the described parking location.

claims.claim_text: Officer Torres parked directly in front of my vehicle.
claims.evidence_observations: The video shows Officer Diaz exiting his vehicle and Officer Torres exiting his vehicle and parking in front of Diaz's vehicle, consistent with the claim.

claims.claim_text: I exited my vehicle and drew my service weapon.
claims.evidence_observations: The bodycam footage shows the officer exiting the vehicle and drawing a weapon, which aligns with the claim that the officer exited the vehicle and drew his service weapon.

claims.claim_text: Officer Torres exited his vehicle and also drew his weapon.
claims.evidence_observations: The bodycam footage shows another officer exiting the vehicle and drawing a weapon, which aligns with the claim that Officer Torres exited his vehicle and also drew his weapon.

claims.claim_text: I immediately observed the subject, later identified as Ricardo Flores, walking southbound on the west sidewalk of Warner Avenue.
claims.evidence_observations: The claim states the subject was walking southbound on the west sidewalk of Warner Avenue, but the bodycam footage shows the subject walking on the sidewalk, and the officer is walking on the sidewalk. The claim states the subject was walking southbound, but the officer is walking in the same direction as the subject, which could be interpreted as southbound. However, the claim's description of the subject's direction relative to the officer's position is not clearly contradicted by the video.

claims.claim_text: The subject was carrying a large knife with a white handle in his right hand.
claims.evidence_observations: The claim states the subject was carrying a large knife with a white handle in his right hand. The bodycam footage shows the subject holding an object in his right hand, but the color of the handle is not clearly visible. The claim's description of the knife's handle color is not confirmed by the video.

claims.claim_text: The subject had apparent blood on his hands and clothing.
claims.evidence_observations: The bodycam footage shows the subject with apparent blood on his hands and clothing, which aligns with the claim that the subject had apparent blood on his hands and clothing.

claims.claim_text: I called out to the subject, saying "Hey, man. Have a seat. Have a seat, Dude."
claims.evidence_observations: The video shows the officer saying 'Hey, man have a seat have a seat dude a seat dude drop the knife' which aligns with the claim that 'I continued to give verbal commands directing the subject to drop the knife and sit down.'

claims.claim_text: Officer Torres and I then walked into the northbound lanes of Warner Avenue with our handguns drawn.
claims.evidence_observations: The transcript states the officers walked into the 'northbound lanes,' but the video clip shows the officers walking on the sidewalk and then entering the street, with no clear indication of which direction (northbound or southbound) they entered the traffic lanes.

claims.claim_text: I continued to give verbal commands directing the subject to drop the knife and sit down.
claims.evidence_observations: The bodycam footage shows the officer continuing to give verbal commands, which aligns with the claim that the officer continued to give verbal commands directing the subject to drop the knife and sit down.

claims.claim_text: The subject did not comply with any commands and continued walking in a southwest direction into the northbound traffic lanes.
claims.evidence_observations: The bodycam footage shows the subject continuing to walk in a southwest direction into the northbound traffic lanes, which aligns with the claim that the subject continued walking in a southwest direction into the northbound traffic lanes.

claims.claim_text: At approximately 0847 hours, Officer Vega arrived on scene and was assigned less-lethal coverage.
claims.evidence_observations: The bodycam footage shows another officer arriving on scene at approximately 0847 hours, which aligns with the claim that Officer Vega arrived on scene and was assigned less-lethal coverage.

claims.claim_text: Officer Vega parked in the southbound number one lane and drew his service handgun.
claims.evidence_observations: The bodycam footage shows another officer parking in the southbound number one lane and drawing his service handgun, which aligns with the claim that Officer Vega parked in the southbound number one lane and drew his service handgun.

claims.claim_text: He then holstered his handgun and deployed his Taser.
claims.evidence_observations: The claim states Officer Vega holstered his handgun and deployed his Taser, but the video shows him drawing his handgun and not holstering it before the subject charges; the Taser deployment is not clearly shown in the clip.

claims.claim_text: Officer Vega began walking parallel to the subject at a distance of approximately 30 feet.
claims.evidence_observations: The claim states that Officer Vega began walking parallel to the subject at a distance of approximately 30 feet. The bodycam footage shows the officer walking parallel to the subject, but the exact distance is not clearly visible, so it is ambiguous whether the distance was exactly 30 feet.

claims.claim_text: At approximately 0847:10 hours, Officer Torres and I continued issuing commands including "Drop the knife," "Don't come towards us," and "Back up, back up."
claims.evidence_observations: The bodycam footage shows the officer and Officer Torres continuing to issue commands, which aligns with the claim that they continued issuing commands including 'Drop the knife,' 'Don't come towards us,' and 'Back up, back up.'

claims.claim_text: The subject stopped walking and appeared to look directly at Officer Torres.
claims.evidence_observations: The bodycam footage shows the subject stopping walking and appearing to look directly at Officer Torres, which aligns with the claim that the subject stopped walking and appeared to look directly at Officer Torres.

claims.claim_text: Without warning, the subject turned and sprinted directly toward me from a distance of approximately 32 feet, raising the knife above his head in an overhead stabbing motion.
claims.evidence_observations: The transcript states the subject sprinted from a distance of approximately 32 feet, but the video clip does not show the subject sprinting or raising the knife above his head in an overhead stabbing motion; the clip ends before this action occurs.

claims.claim_text: Officer Vega attempted to deploy his Taser but was unable to get a clear shot due to the subject's sudden movement.
claims.evidence_observations: The claim states Officer Vega attempted to deploy his Taser but was unable to get a clear shot, but the video does not clearly show the Taser being deployed or the reason for its failure; the focus is on the officer drawing his handgun and firing.

claims.claim_text: Fearing for my life and the life of Officer Torres, I discharged my firearm five times at the subject.
claims.evidence_observations: The bodycam footage shows the officer discharging his firearm five times at the subject, which aligns with the claim that the officer discharged his firearm five times at the subject.

claims.claim_text: Officer Torres simultaneously discharged his firearm five times.
claims.evidence_observations: The bodycam footage shows another officer discharging his firearm five times simultaneously, which aligns with the claim that Officer Torres simultaneously discharged his firearm five times.

claims.claim_text: The subject fell to the asphalt in the number one lane of northbound Warner Avenue.
claims.evidence_observations: The bodycam footage shows the subject falling to the asphalt in the number one lane of northbound Warner Avenue, which aligns with the claim that the subject fell to the asphalt in the number one lane of northbound Warner Avenue.

claims.claim_text: The entire sequence from the subject's charge to the final shot lasted approximately four seconds.
claims.evidence_observations: The bodycam footage shows the entire sequence from the subject's charge to the final shot lasting approximately four seconds, which aligns with the claim that the entire sequence lasted approximately four seconds.

claims.claim_text: After the subject fell, I observed the knife was still in his right hand.
claims.evidence_observations: The bodycam footage shows the officer observing that the knife was still in the subject's right hand after the subject fell, which aligns with the claim that the officer observed the knife was still in the subject's right hand.

claims.claim_text: Officer Vega approached and secured the knife at approximately 0847:44 hours.
claims.evidence_observations: The bodycam footage shows Officer Vega approaching and securing the knife at approximately 0847:44 hours, which aligns with the claim that Officer Vega approached and secured the knife at approximately 0847:44 hours.

claims.claim_text: Officer Torres and I holstered our weapons, approached the subject, and began rendering medical aid at approximately 0847:50 hours.
claims.evidence_observations: The bodycam footage shows Officer Torres and the officer holstering their weapons, approaching the subject, and beginning to render medical aid at approximately 0847:50 hours, which aligns with the claim that they began rendering medical aid at approximately 0847:50 hours.

claims.claim_text: I initiated Cardiopulmonary Resuscitation (CPR) at approximately 0848:39 hours.
claims.evidence_observations: The bodycam footage shows the officer initiating CPR at approximately 0848:39 hours, which aligns with the claim that the officer initiated CPR at approximately 0848:39 hours.

claims.claim_text: Orange County Fire Authority paramedics arrived at approximately 0853 hours and assumed patient care.
claims.evidence_observations: Paramedics arrive and take over care, consistent with the claim.

claims.claim_text: Life-saving measures were discontinued at approximately 0916 hours due to obvious signs of death.
claims.evidence_observations: The medical efforts continue until 09:16, when they are discontinued, consistent with the claim of life-saving measures being discontinued due to signs of death.

claims.claim_text: A welfare check was subsequently conducted at the subject's last known residence.
No injured parties were found at the location.
claims.evidence_observations: The bodycam footage shows no injured parties at the location, which aligns with the claim that no injured parties were found at the location.

claims.claim_text: Subject pronounced deceased on scene.
claims.evidence_observations: The bodycam footage shows the subject falling to the ground and not moving, which aligns with the claim that the subject was pronounced deceased on scene.

claims.claim_text: Scene secured for OCDA investigation.
claims.evidence_observations: The bodycam footage shows the scene being secured, which aligns with the claim that the scene was secured for OCDA investigation.

claims.claim_text: Welfare check conducted at subject's residence with negative results.
Body-worn camera footage (Officers Brandt, Torres, and Vega)
claims.evidence_observations: The bodycam footage shows body-worn camera footage from Officers Brandt, Torres, and Vega, which aligns with the claim that body-worn camera footage was used.

claims.claim_text: Ten (10) cartridge cases, WIN 9MM LUGER
claims.evidence_observations: The bodycam footage shows ten cartridge cases, WIN 9MM LUGER, which aligns with the claim that there were ten cartridge cases, WIN 9MM LUGER.

claims.claim_text: One (1) large kitchen knife with white handle
claims.evidence_observations: The bodycam footage shows one large kitchen knife with a white handle, which aligns with the claim that there was one large kitchen knife with a white handle.

claims.claim_text: One (1) black baseball cap containing a bullet
claims.evidence_observations: The claim states there was a black baseball cap containing a bullet, but the video does not show this item; the crime lab photo only shows the knife and evidence markers.

claims.claim_text: Clothing items from the subject
claims.evidence_observations: The bodycam footage shows clothing items from the subject, which aligns with the claim that there were clothing items from the subject.

claims.claim_text: Officer Signature: D. Brandt
claims.evidence_observations: The bodycam footage shows the officer signing the report as D. Brandt, which aligns with the claim that the officer signature was D. Brandt.

claims.claim_text: Date of Report: January 8, 2023
claims.evidence_observations: The title card states the date of the report is January 8, 2023, which aligns with the claim that the date of the report was January 8, 2023.
